content.text: The difference between a sovereign store and a manual operation is not scale — it is [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-google-apps-script-digital-commerce-31|architecture]]. A manual operation requires your attention for every order. A sovereign store processes orders identically whether you are watching or not, whether it is midnight or noon, whether it receives one order or fifty simultaneously. [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/now[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-what-actually-how-17|COREMERCH guide to payment]]s-integration-static-site-crypto-payments-what-actually-19|NOWPayments Integration]] monitors the blockchain continuously. The webhook fires the moment a transaction receives on-chain confirmations. Your Cloudflare Worker receives the webhook, validates the signature, confirms the transaction independently on the blockchain, logs the order to your Supabase database, generates a presigned download URL from Cloudflare R2 with a configurable expiry time, and sends the delivery email via Resend. The buyer receives their product before they have navigated away from the payment confirmation page.
What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Google apps

Google Apps Script is a powerful automation tool that allows digital creators to streamline their commerce processes without reliance on conventional payment platforms. This script can automate tasks, such as sending emails or managing orders, with minimal setup. For creators operating in financial isolation, having a reliable automation tool means they can efficiently deliver their digital products immediately after payment confirmation, thus enhancing customer satisfaction and retention.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of Google Apps Script in a digital commerce setup typically involves a combination of various components. When a customer makes a purchase, the payment is processed through NOWPayments, which sends a webhook to Google Apps Script. This script then retrieves order details from Supabase or Google Sheets, triggering an email with download links for the purchased products. A correctly configured sovereign stack can process these orders in under 30 seconds, ensuring a smooth transaction experience for both creators and customers.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This automation solution is designed specifically for digital creators in regions where conventional payment platforms like PayPal and Stripe are restricted. It empowers artists, educators, and software developers to take control of their sales without the complexities of traditional payment systems. By providing a reliable means of processing payments and delivering products, Google Apps Script serves those who seek independence in their digital commerce endeavors.
Automate your digital delivery process without reliance on Stripe.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The effectiveness of Google Apps Script in digital commerce relies on several key components working in harmony. Cloudflare Workers can handle up to 100,000 webhook events per day on the free tier, allowing for robust order processing. Supabase or Google Sheets serves as the order database, storing transaction details securely. NOWPayments plays a vital role in processing payments and sending real-time notifications to trigger the automation process. Together, these components create a seamless workflow that ensures timely product delivery.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start deploying Google Apps Script for your digital commerce needs, first, set up your sovereign stack. Choose the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for a comprehensive solution. Configure your Google Apps Script to handle incoming webhooks from NOWPayments, ensuring it retrieves order data from your chosen storage solution. Finally, set up email automation to send download links to your customers. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more resources and support.
How does automated digital product delivery work with crypto payments?

Automated digital product delivery works by using webhooks to trigger actions after a crypto payment confirms. When a payment is processed through NOWPayments, it sends a webhook to the configured backend, which can be Google Apps Script. This script then retrieves the order details and automatically sends an email with the download link to the customer.

Your Deployment Checklist

Set the webhook secret key before you test anything — this is the most commonly skipped step and it causes silent failures where webhooks arrive but are rejected before any processing occurs. Configure the same secret key string in your NOWPayments IPN settings and in your backend environment variables or Apps Script properties. Deploy your backend and confirm the endpoint returns HTTP 200 to a test POST request. Upload a test product file and configure it in your backend product list. Send a real mainnet transaction to your configured wallet address and watch your backend logs in real time. Confirm the webhook arrives, the signature validates, the transaction confirms on-chain, the order logs, and the delivery email sends with a working link.
Frequently Asked Questions
How does automated digital product delivery work with crypto payments?

Automated digital product delivery involves integrating a payment processor like NOWPayments with a backend system, such as Google Apps Script. When a customer makes a payment, the processor sends a webhook to the backend, which retrieves order details and sends download links to the customer automatically.
What is a webhook and how does it trigger order fulfillment?

A webhook is a method used to send real-time data from one application to another when an event occurs. In this context, when a payment is confirmed, the payment processor sends a webhook to the backend, prompting it to fulfill the order by sending the appropriate product information to the customer.
Can I automatically send download links after a crypto payment confirms?

Yes, you can automatically send download links using a system that integrates NOWPayments and Google Apps Script. This setup allows your backend to respond to payment confirmations by sending an email with the download link, ensuring timely delivery of your digital products.
What are the benefits of using Google Apps Script for this purpose?

Google Apps Script offers flexibility and ease of use for automating tasks related to digital commerce. It enables seamless integration with Google services, making it easier to manage orders and send communications without requiring complex setups or additional costs.
How can I ensure my system is reliable?

To ensure reliability, configure your Google Apps Script properly to handle webhooks and test the entire workflow from payment to delivery. Using proven components like NOWPayments and robust data storage solutions, such as Supabase, will enhance your system's reliability.
